export interface RecordSchemaProps extends SchemaProps {
  partial?: boolean
}

interface RecordKeyAndElementProps extends SchemaProps {
  required?: AtLeastOnce
  hidden?: false
  key?: false
  savedAs?: undefined
  keyDefault?: undefined
  putDefault?: undefined
  updateDefault?: undefined

}
